questions.stem: A student says 'nuclear power stations produce no pollution at all'. Which of the following is the best response?

options.text: Incorrect, nuclear power stations produce radioactive waste that must be stored safely for many years
Correct, nuclear power produces no waste of any kind
Correct, uranium is a clean fuel
Incorrect, nuclear power stations produce more carbon dioxide than coal stations

questions.explanation: While nuclear power stations do not produce greenhouse gases during electricity generation (unlike fossil fuels), they do produce radioactive waste. High-level waste remains dangerously radioactive for thousands of years and must be stored securely. There are also environmental concerns about mining uranium and decommissioning old plants.
